description.desc_thousand_char: GLS Films Industries Private Limited (GFIPL), as per its credit rating report, is engaged in the business of manufacturing flexible packaging solutions such as printed film, printed pouch, printed laminated paper, VMCH (Vinyl Methyl Chloride) foil, printing cylinder, and many more. It caters to industry segments including food and beverage, FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods), pharmaceutical, industrial, and agro-based products. The company has having manufacturing plant in Gurugram, Haryana. Their manufacturing set-up at Gurgaon has Rotogravure printing capabilities of up to 9 colors and lamination capabilities to produce solvent-based adhesive lamination, solvent-free adhesive lamination, and extraction lamination. The finishing operations are well equipped with technologies that include Shrink sleeves of PVC and PET in cut and roll form, UV-cured coatings, water-based heat seal coatings, hot melt-coated soap wrappers, and many more. It is an ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 certified company.
